catalyst.name: Property: Unavoidable, Tessellation Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Your explosive [projectile | shape | language] inherents subclass debuffs based on its element.
Deals an additional instance of 165 [10] damage in a 10 meter radius and applies a debuff matching its element:
•70 Scorch Stacks (80 with Ember of Ashes)
•Weaken for 6 [2.5] seconds
•Blind for 9 seconds
•80 Slow Stacks
•Sever for 5 seconds (7.5 with Thread of Continuity)
Effects are applied after the explosion.
